summary: South Carolina Forestry Commission tower in Clarendon County, recorded as removed; no build date, height or fire history in the sources read.

facts.status_note: The register and the Forest Lookouts site both record the tower as removed.

events.note: The Forestry Commission closed its whole fire tower system on October 1, 1993. The sources read do not date this tower's own removal
Registered in the Former Fire Lookout Sites register on April 7, 2011

notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three records. No build date, staffing, fire or tower-height information in any source read. The FFLOS 'Elevation 98 ft (30 m)' is ground elevation of the site, not tower height, so it is not used as a height. The removal date is not given anywhere; the commission-wide closure (1 Oct 1993) is recorded only as context, not as this tower's removal date. The OpenStreetMap node (357111601) still carries the name 'Foreston Lookout Tower' with tower type 'observation', which may be a map carry-over and is not evidence of a standing structure. Two web searches and about six page reads were used. The story is kept short (about 150 words) rather than padded. A future pass could check Clarendon County or Manning newspapers for the tower's history.
